ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Family Psychology - Students will: (a) examine theories and empirical literature on family relationships, (b) articulate how family relationships impact the mental health of individual family members, and (c) articulate the connections between family relationships, mental health, and their socio-cultural context with an emphasis on ethnocultural background, social support systems, and human services. Prerequesites: PSYC 100 and Junior or Senior standing.
